description: POI category names follow the rules locale of the map (en_US), never the language of the user (#25941). 'Bank' is the bank category and the banks, not the benches of the Swedish 'Bänk'; 'Paris' finds only the bakeries called so, not the bookmakers of the French 'Preneur de paris'; 'Hardware store' is the hardware category, the whole name takes 'store'. The negative cases 'Billa' and 'Kino' are covered by SpatialPoiCategorySynonymsTest.
